widget.name: Recursive Container
widget.description: Renders a tree structure recursively. Define the card/content once — the widget repeats it for every node and its children automatically.

property.caption: Nodes
property.description: All nodes in the tree. The widget will build the tree client-side using the parent association.

property.caption: Content
property.description: Drop widgets here once. They will be rendered for every node in the tree.

property.caption: Parent association
property.description: The association that points to the parent of each node. Can be a direct self-referencing association (e.g. Node_Node) or a path through an intermediate entity. The widget uses this to build the tree client-side.

property.caption: Max depth
property.description: Maximum recursion depth to prevent infinite loops. Default is 25.
